title: Add PHY Header TLV to IEEE 802.15.4 TAP Dissector
description:
IEEE 802.15.4 SUN FSK supports a Mode Switch PHR which contains no payload.  Wi-SUN PHY 1.1 defines a slightly different PHR format but using the SUN FSK PHR's MS enabled bit.

The PHY Header (PHR) may be captured and exported by supporting packet sniffers.  This TLV provides a means for those sniffers to export the PHR to wireshark.

This TLV is formatted according to description added to IEEE 802.15.4-TAP protocol document found at
https://github.com/jkcko/ieee802.15.4-tap/pull/5/commits/66fc57d2e396fcb8d903a9a92b98e588cd7684f7
